your_book:
Monday was a broadly constructive session for Jaleel's book, though the headline account value of $22,369 still sits $150 in the red overall (−0.68% unrealized). The two standout movers were ServiceNow (+7.17%, $2,435) and Adobe (+5.88%, $3,734) — both surging despite a sector-wide AI-disruption headline tied to OpenAI's reported 'Presence' agentic product, which normally would have been a headwind for legacy software. NOW's move is particularly notable given it already carries an elevated concentration flag; the session's gain is welcome but it deepens the single-name risk at 10.9% of the book. NVIDIA, by contrast, was the lone decliner at −4.85% ($1,284), giving back ground even as headlines cited aggressive data-center buying activity — a split tape that warrants watching heading into its August 26 print.

The drift story is clearest in RKLB and LULU. Rocket Lab bounced +3.76% today but remains down −24.7% on Jaleel's cost basis at $2,122 — a 9.5% weight rated AVOID with a QARP of just 45.2; price and thesis are plainly opposed. Lululemon also ticked up +3.16% but sits −7.8% in the hole with a live guidance-cut flag and Americas comps down five straight quarters. BSX (+3.3%) looks constructive on the surface, but its next earnings are Tuesday, July 29, and management already guided flat through Q3 after slashing FY26 growth targets — today's gain could reverse fast.

Abbott (+1.61%, +21.1% gain) and Zoetis (+2.14%, −2.3% gain) were quiet but steady, consistent with their defensive roles. The pharma cluster — GILD, NVS, NBIX, VRTX — all crept higher on light volume with the drug-pricing policy overhang still unresolved ahead of an August 4 date to watch. Cash sits at $504 (2.3% of the account), leaving little dry powder if any of the elevated-risk names deteriorate.

attention.headline: AVOID-rated at 9.5% weight, −24.7% in the hole
attention.note: Jaleel's largest risk-adjusted drag: a near-10% position rated AVOID with a QARP of 45.2 and no thesis support — the session bounce doesn't change the fundamental case, and the size demands an explicit hold-or-exit decision.

attention.headline: Earnings in two days with guidance already slashed
attention.note: BSX reports July 29 having already cut FY26 growth from 10.5% to 7–8.5% and guided flat through Q3; the +3.3% session gain could be entirely unwound on the print, and the elevated risk flag is live.

attention.headline: Biggest weight surged 7%+ on a day its sector faced an AI-disruption headline
attention.note: The rally is a pleasant surprise, but at 10.9% of the book and a high multiple, NOW amplifies any software de-rate — today's divergence from the OpenAI 'Presence' selloff narrative needs a reason, not just a price.

attention.headline: Sole decliner (−4.85%) while AI data-center headlines were bullish
attention.note: NVDA selling off on a day flagged for aggressive AI infrastructure buying is a conflicting signal; with export-control risk live and earnings August 26, the divergence is worth tracking closely.
